newsitem.title: USA: Falls Church, Va., city manager to join muni firm.
newsitem.headline: Falls Church, Va., city manager to join muni firm.

text.p: Falls Church, Va., city manager David Lasso is resigning to take a job at the municipal law firm Venable, Baetjer and Howard LLP, the Washington Post said Friday.
Lasso, 44, will work at the law firm's Tysons Corner office.

He became city manager in 1993 after serving 11 years as a city attorney for Falls Church. He came under fire in July for asking the police department to audit long-distance phone calls made by city employees, the newspaper said. At least two city council members have said they were seeking to fire him.
Lasso said the criticism had influencd his decision to resign.

However, he told the newspaper, "My primary reason was simply to look forward to the future and do what was best for my family and me. I think this is a great opportunity that under the best circumstances would be difficult to throw away."
